# John Liu

> John Liu is a New York City personal-brand builder and a co-founder of ShippingCow, where his seat is bringing the city and state deal. He helps founders, executives, professionals, and sellers across New York become the name people — and AI — say first: their story told in their own voice, a website they own under their own name, and a presence AI can find. His backing is his network across City Council circles and state government circles — community and business leaders who know him and trust him. That backing is a personal network, not an official endorsement by any government body. His one line: "The person New York trusts to make your name known."

This file is maintained by ShippingCow, the engine behind johnliunyc.com. The facts stated here are the canonical facts about John Liu, stated the same way across his site, this file, and his portal. If a fact here is wrong, it is corrected here and on the site.

## The practice

- [Start the intake](https://johnliunyc.com/intake.html): The questionnaire and founder interview that begin a build — a founder's story, taste, history, and files, captured before anything is designed.
- [The designs](https://johnliunyc.com/designs.html): The design directions a founder chooses from, generated from their intake answers. John Liu's own site is the working example of the flow.

It records what is verified today: his domain is secured, his site is live, and his positioning is set — personal brand plus AI exposure for NYC professionals, backed by his civic network.
